newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar down, weaker prices seen.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar down, weaker prices seen.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures stood barely firmer at midsession after early trade selling failed to erode support in the July contract, traders said.

The selling pressured the most-active month to a low of 11.37, where speculative buying limited losses. A dearth of selling between 11.40 and 11.50 allowed the spot month to run up to the day's high of 11.54 cents.
But by midsession, prices eased off the highs amid outright producer selling in July, and trade selling in the July/October and October/March spreads.
Trading sources noted demand around current levels, but said the market is likely to drift lower in the near term as the speculators roll July positions into October.
Support was seen from 11.20 to 11.00 cents in July.
At 1130 EDT, the July contract stood 0.01 cent higher at 11.42, having ranged from 11.54 to 11.37 cents. October was up 0.03 to 11.24, and the back months stood 0.01 and 0.02 firmer.
An estimated 9,286 lots changed hands as of 1100 EDT.
The Commitment of Traders Report released after the close is expected to show an extremely heavy speculative net long position, which could attract steady selling by the trade.
As of early Thursday, open interest in July fell 2,181 lots to 77,703 lots. October gained 1,571 lots to stand at 61,020 lots.
The July options expiry on June 15 and the expiry of the July futures contract on June 30, is expected to prompt additional selling, dealers said.
